subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should managed outgoing-image HTTP requests accept paired Control UI device tokens with `operator.read`, or should this fix remain limited to resolving previews through the authenticated `artifacts.download` RPC?
rationale: Both designs fix the reported preview flow, but the direct HTTP option expands a credential-acceptance boundary and requires explicit owner intent rather than automation inference.

options.title: Keep Both Authenticated Paths
options.body: Rebase the PR and retain both RPC byte resolution and paired-device HTTP access after a focused Gateway authorization review.

options.title: Narrow To Artifact RPC
options.body: Remove the new paired-device HTTP authorization and fix workspace previews solely through authenticated `artifacts.download` byte resolution.

options.title: Pause For Auth Redesign
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a different capability-URL or media-ticket design for browser navigation.

recommendation.title: Keep Both Authenticated Paths
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and retain both RPC byte resolution and paired-device HTTP access after a focused Gateway authorization review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to managed-image HTTP loading and its Gateway runtime boundary.
